newsitem.title: USA: Wells Fargo sees Q2 EPS below expectations.
newsitem.headline: Wells Fargo sees Q2 EPS below expectations.

text.p: Wells Fargo & Co said Wednesday its second quarter earnings will not meet analysts' expectations.
The company said it estimates earnings will be down 30 percent from the first quarter, or about $1 below analysts' consensus estimate of $3.53 per share, as reported by Zacks Investment Research.
Wells Fargo earned $3.62 per share in the first quarter of 1997.

It attributed the shortfall to one-time, unexpected expenses related to the resolution of various operational and back-office issues related to the First Interstate Bancorp integration, including clearing accounts with other banks.
Wells Fargo completed its $11 billion merger with First Interstate in April 1996.
Second quarter earnings will be released on July 15, the company said.
